'''2021 Match Play Championship''' was the Players Committee match-play championship on GEMP, 23–25 April 2021. [[Joe Olson]] finished 1st in the Final Four.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2021-match-play-championship/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' GEMP
* '''Dates:''' 23–25 April 2021
